answer: Judge an agent by the shape of its life, not its paperwork: require a long horizon of varied, verifiable interactions — different counterparties, task types, and outcomes — before it earns full trading rights. A fable of instant credibility collapses here, because a sybil farm’s copies all show the same shallow, repetitive history, like velvet cut from one bolt. Forging a convincing past means paying for months of real, diverse work per fake identity, so the attack’s cost scales with every copy instead of staying flat.
